summary: Iteration-8 retest of the 4 iteration-7 defects. VERIFIED FIXED: (1) CRITICAL Learn article routing — all 6 article ids open via card click and direct URL in both /learn/{id} and /demo/learn/{id}; article-title/article-body render, article-back-button returns to /learn, article-ask-ai-button seeds the prompt into ask-finaura-input; (2) LoadingScreen brand now 'FINAURA AI'; (3) backend memory upsert preserves id + created_at with updated_at advancing and a single row per key. STILL BROKEN: dark-theme contrast is only partially fixed — 6 element groups still render light text (#e2e8f0) on light backgrounds (unreadable). Backend: 9/9 new iteration-8 tests, 27/27 phase-4, 63 passed/6 skipped regression = 100%. Frontend flows (goals CRUD, profile persist, what-if run, memory-aware chat returning ₹65,000, demo mode) all pass.

minor.issue: Still open from iteration 7: monthly history is all-zero once the profile is populated, so the dashboard cash-flow chart / tooltip shows ₹0 for every month (tooltip verified: 'May expenses ₹0 income ₹0').
Still open: fixed per-user session_id with no reset path. Also response markdown is returned with raw '**' markers and the UI renders them literally.

design_issues.screen: Dark theme (data-theme='dark') — remaining unreadable elements (measured contrast ratios via getComputedStyle)
issues: .insight (Dashboard 'Worth noticing') — color #e2e8f0 on background rgb(241,250,246), ratio 1.16. auth.css:251 sets only the dark text color, never overrides the light .insight background.
.prompt (Ask page 'TRY ASKING' cards) — color #e2e8f0 on rgb(255,255,255), ratio 1.23 (3 buttons unreadable).
native <select> controls — What-If goal picker, Profile 'Financial experience'/'Risk tolerance': color #e2e8f0 on rgb(251,253,252), ratio ~1.2.
.alert-card (Financial Changes page) — color #e2e8f0 on rgb(255,247,233), ratio ~1.2; whole alert body unreadable.
.article-ai-cta (article footer 'Keep learning' block) — color #e2e8f0 on rgb(244,247,245), unreadable.
.chat-body on /ask stays light rgb(251,253,252) inside an otherwise dark chat card — inconsistent panel (bubbles themselves are fine at 11.9:1 / 14.4:1).

design_issues.screen: Dark theme — mint (accent) buttons, sub-AA but legible
issues: White text on #10b981 gives 2.54:1 for .primary-btn ('New goal', 'Save profile', 'Run simulation'), mint .pill-btn ('Save', 'Set PIN'), active .theme-choice ('Dark') and active .model-pill ('GPT') — below WCAG AA 4.5:1; darken the mint or use a dark foreground.
On /learn/{id} and /demo/learn/{id} the topbar eyebrow+title and the sidebar active item still say 'Dashboard' (article route missing from the title/nav map).
Profile 'Date of birth' uses the browser-native date input instead of the shadcn calendar component.

action_items: Dark theme: add background overrides (not just color) for .insight, .prompt, .alert-card, .article-ai-cta, .chat-body and native select/option in :root[data-theme='dark'] — they are currently light-bg with light text (1.1–1.3:1).
Dark theme: raise contrast on mint-filled controls (white on #10b981 = 2.54:1).
Add the /learn/{id} route to the topbar-title + sidebar-active map so article pages don't show 'Dashboard'.
Optional/carried over: make 6-month history consistent with profile-derived summary (cash-flow chart & tooltip currently ₹0), render chat markdown instead of raw '**'.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.css dark overrides set only `color` for .insight (line 251) and similar blocks; any component with a hardcoded light background needs a paired background override — consider driving these from CSS variables instead of per-selector overrides.
App.js is still ~1076 lines with Dashboard/Goals/Learn/Ask/Settings inline; article routing is now a manual pathname branch (works) but should move into the Routes tree.
App.js AppWorkspace maps pages by path but the Shell title/nav map omits /learn/:id, causing the wrong page header.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all functional flows pass; dark-theme contrast partially unfixed)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted memory key 'preserve_test' (income) for testuser@finaura.dev; deleted the leftover 'TEST_iso_key' memory from iteration 7 (only 'monthly_income' = ₹65,000 remains); created and deleted goal 'TEST_i8_goal'; profile occupation set to 'QA Engineer i8'; theme restored to light.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Learn article routing is fixed and verified for all 6 ids in auth + demo mode; memory upsert preservation is covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py. Only dark-theme contrast remains: reproduce by logging in, /settings -> [data-testid='theme-dark'], then page.evaluate contrast on .insight (Dashboard), .prompt (/ask), select (/whatif, /profile), .alert-card (/changes), .article-ai-cta (/learn/emergency-funds). Note the Ask send button testid is 'ask-finaura-send-button' (not 'ask-send-button'), and goals use 'create-goal-button'/'save-goal-button'/'delete-goal-{id}'.
rca_of_the_issue: Dark-theme fixes in auth.css only override text `color` for blocks whose light background is hardcoded on the base rule (.insight #f1faf6, .prompt #fff, .alert-card #fff7e9, .article-ai-cta #f4f7f5, .chat-body #fbfdfc, native selects #fbfdfc). With text forced to #e2e8f0 the result is light-on-light at ~1.2:1. Each needs a matching dark `background`/`border` override (or migration to theme CSS variables).
